curtain.ask: Curtain bangs that start at the bridge of the nose, blended into long layers from the cheekbones down.

layers.ask: Keep the length. Face-framing layers that start at the chin, and long layers through the back for movement.

lob.ask: A lob a little longer at the front than the back, ending 3 to 5 cm below the chin, with soft ends.

bob.ask: A bob that ends at the chin, with soft volume at the sides and a light side part.

sideswept.ask: A deep side part with a long fringe swept across the forehead, ending at the cheekbone.

pixie.ask: A textured pixie, longer on top with a side fringe, short and soft around the ears.

shag.ask: A soft shag: lots of layers through the crown and sides, and a wispy curtain fringe.

waves.ask: Shoulder-length hair with long layers, styled in loose waves from the cheekbones down.

curlybob.ask: A rounded bob cut dry, curl by curl, with the most volume at the jaw.

crown.n: Curls with height at the crown
crown.ask: Layers cut to stack curls at the crown, with the sides kept a little closer.

pony.ask: For long hair: a sleek pony at crown height. Leave two thin face-framing pieces out if you want it softer.

fullbangs.n: Full fringe that skims the brows
fullbangs.ask: A full, soft fringe that ends just at the brows, a little longer at the sides.

butterfly.ask: A butterfly cut: keep the length, shortest layers at the cheekbones blended into long layers, blow-dried round and out.

italianbob.ask: An Italian bob: blunt and full at the ends, just below the jaw, with soft, bent ends and a deep side part.

frenchbob.n: French bob with a soft fringe
frenchbob.ask: A French bob: just above the jaw at the front, soft texture, and a light fringe that touches the brows.

wolf.ask: A wolf cut: short, choppy layers at the crown, curtain fringe, length kept at the back and thinned out.

bixie.ask: A bixie: short at the nape, longer pieces around the ears and a long, side-swept fringe.

quiff.ask: Short tapered sides, 7 to 10 cm on top, pushed up and back at the front with matte texture.

sidepart.ask: A side part on your natural parting, scissor-cut on top, tapered (not faded) at the sides.

crew.ask: A crew cut: number 2 or 3 on the sides, a little longer on top, slightly longer at the front.

buzz.ask: A number 2 to 4 all over, with a neat, natural neckline.

crop.ask: A textured crop: skin or low fade at the sides, choppy texture on top, fringe cut straight just above the brows.

fringe.ask: Keep 8 to 10 cm at the front and sweep it to one side. Medium taper at the sides.

flow.ask: Grow it to the ears or jaw, with light layers. Tuck it behind the ears or push it back loosely.

fade.ask: A high skin fade, with 5 to 7 cm of textured length on top.

slick.ask: 10 to 12 cm on top to comb back, sides tapered short.

curlytop.ask: A low or mid taper, with 5 to 8 cm of curls on top cut dry so they keep their shape.

lineup.n: Short coils with a sharp line-up
lineup.ask: Even length on top, a taper at the sides, and a sharp line-up at the forehead and temples.

lowtaper.ask: A low taper fade, starting just above the ear, with 5 to 7 cm of textured length on top.

mullet.ask: A modern mullet: textured on top, tapered at the sides, about 5 cm longer at the back, kept soft.

frenchcrop.ask: A French crop: short sides, 3 to 5 cm on top pushed forward, fringe cut straight across.

warrior.ask: Grow it to the chin or below. Long layers, pushed back with a light cream, ends left natural.

twoblock.ask: A two-block: sides clipped short (no fade), 8 to 10 cm on top, parted in the middle into a curtain fringe.

stubble.ask: Keep it at 3 to 5 mm. Clean the neckline 2 fingers above the Adam's apple.

boxed.ask: About 1 cm long, with sharp cheek lines and a straight neckline.

full.n: Full beard, rounded at the chin
full.ask: Grow 6 to 8 weeks, then shape it rounded at the chin, a little shorter on the cheeks.

goatee.ask: Keep the chin 1 to 2 cm, with a moustache that connects or almost connects. Clean cheeks.

circle.ask: A moustache joined to a rounded chin beard, cheeks shaved clean.

chinstrap.ask: A short beard that follows the jaw from ear to ear, about 1 cm wide.

clean.ask: Shave with the grain, and calm the skin after.

balbo.ask: A balbo: a moustache left separate from a 1 to 2 cm chin beard that runs along the jaw a little. Cheeks clean.

fadedbeard.ask: Fade the sideburns from skin into the beard. Keep the jaw about 5 mm and the chin about 1 cm.
